#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
ROOT=/mnt/c/Users/h_kis/Desktop/B-Free-master/Program/bfree_x86_64
cd "$ROOT"
export PATH="${HOME}/x86_64-elf-toolchain/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:${PATH:-}"
BB="$ROOT/.cache/busybox-src"
BB_VER=1.36.1
TAR="$ROOT/.cache/busybox-${BB_VER}.tar.bz2"

echo "[1] restore ash.c from tarball"
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
tar -xjf "$TAR" -C "$tmp" "busybox-${BB_VER}/shell/ash.c"
cp -f "$tmp/busybox-${BB_VER}/shell/ash.c" "$BB/shell/ash.c"
rm -rf "$tmp"

# Re-apply B-Free ash prerequisites that build_guest_busybox does
sed -i 's/depends on !NOMMU//g' "$BB/shell/ash.c" "$BB/shell/Config.src" 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i 's/if !NOMMU &&/if/g' "$BB/shell/ash.c" "$BB/shell/Config.src" 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i 's/# error "Do not even bother, ash will not run on NOMMU machine"//' "$BB/shell/ash.c" || true
sed -i 's/pid = fork();/pid = vfork();/g' "$BB/shell/ash.c" || true
# skip freejob under vfork (from bfree_patch_ash_vfork_support) — optional if present in patcher
if ! grep -q 'skip freejob under shared-AS vfork' "$BB/shell/ash.c"; then
  # soft: leave freejob as upstream; prior builds had `if (0) for`
  :
fi

# Ensure NOEXEC force-exec for cat etc. if previously applied via other means — leave as-is from config

echo "[2] apply seq-fork + pipe-scoped AS-copy"
sed -i 's/\r$//' tools/bfree_patch_ash_pipe_seq_fork.py
python3 tools/bfree_patch_ash_pipe_seq_fork.py "$BB/shell/ash.c"

if ! grep -q 'bfree_linux_fork' "$BB/libbb/appletlib.c"; then
  cat >> "$BB/libbb/appletlib.c" <<'EOF'

#include <sys/syscall.h>
/* B-Free: real Linux fork for ash pipelines (AS-copy in guest kernel). */
pid_t bfree_linux_fork(void)
{
	return (pid_t)syscall(SYS_fork);
}
EOF
fi

echo "markers:"
grep -n 'seq fork pipe\|pipe AS-copy\|bfree_ash_pipe_as_copy\|bfree_linux_fork\|pid = vfork' "$BB/shell/ash.c" | head -30

echo "[3] rebuild ash+busybox"
cd "$BB"
rm -f shell/ash.o
make -j"$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4)" CC=musl-gcc \
  EXTRA_CFLAGS="-Dfork=vfork -Dexit=bfree_safe_exit" \
  LDFLAGS="-static -Wl,-z,norelro -Wl,-Ttext-segment=0x500000" \
  shell/ash.o busybox
nm shell/ash.o | grep bfree_linux_fork
cp -f busybox "$ROOT/userland/busybox_guest/busybox.elf"
cp -f busybox "$ROOT/iso_root/boot/busybox.elf"
cp -f "$ROOT/kernel/kernel.elf" "$ROOT/iso_root/boot/kernel.elf"
echo REBUILD_OK
